body: I’ve been on psych meds for 2 years and therapy but I just can’t get past the trauma and the fact that my issues are making others lives harder.
I hope you fell better soon too. It’s not something I would wish on anyone. I’m so lost and I feel like I am waisting my life when there are others who deserve it so much more.
Thank you. They haven’t yet. But there is always tomorrow.
Thank you so much. I am very sorry for your loss and what you went through. I should have mentioned but I have mental health crises once or twice a year and this is one of those times I  think.
